name: go-quality-scorer
title: Go Code Quality Scorer
description: Go project code quality scoring system based on ISO/IEC 25010 and ISO/IEC 5055 CISQ. Six-dimension scoring framework, with D3 maintainability adding refined size and complexity assessment.
author: go-quality-scorer team

changes: ✨ D3 maintainability dimension extended: 6 new size and complexity metrics
✨ New tool support: gocognit (cognitive complexity), scc (code size statistics)
✨ 3 new red-line rules (CC > 50, Avg CC > 25, SLOC > 2000)
🔄 D3 score fusion: D3_Final = Base(60%) + ScaleComplexity(40%)
📖 New detailed D3 guide and migration documentation
🔧 Performance optimization: collection and scoring algorithm improvements
📊 Output format upgrade: new D3_base and D3_scale_complexity fields
📊 Full support: gocyclo, golangci-lint, go test, gosec and other tools
🔍 Issue detection: code format, complexity, security, coverage, etc.
📈 Grade rating: A/B/C/D/F five-level rating system

features: ✅ Six-dimension scoring framework (D1 correctness 25%, D2 security 20%, D3 maintainability 20%, D4 testing 15%, D5 architecture 12%, D6 performance 8%)
✅ D3 scale-complexity extension: 6 new metrics (Avg CC, Peak CC, Cognitive CC, SLOC, function length, MI)
✅ Veto red lines: 9 key rules (including 3 new rules)
✅ Automated collection: gocyclo, gocognit, scc, golangci-lint, go test, gosec, etc.
✅ JSON output: complete structured report, easy to integrate with CI/CD
✅ Grade rating: A/B/C/D/F five-level rating system

quick_start.step_1: Install tools: brew install gocyclo golangci-lint scc && go install github.com/uudashr/gocognit/cmd/gocognit@latest && go install github.com/securego/gosec/v2/cmd/gosec@latest

breaking_changes: D3 scoring algorithm changed (fuses Base + ScaleComplexity)
D3 average score drops by 3-8 points (stricter assessment)
compatible: D1-D2, D4-D6 dimension scoring algorithms unchanged
JSON output format backward compatible (new fields added)
